title: Top 10 Ways to Actually Stick to a Morning Routine
description: Ninety-three percent of people who start a new morning routine quit within two weeks. These ten changes are what actually made mine stick.
transcript: Ninety-three percent of people who start a new morning routine quit within two weeks. I was one of them, three separate times, before something finally clicked. Here are the ten specific changes that made the difference.
hook_text: Ninety-three percent of people who start a new morning routine quit within two weeks.
